khai.tagline: reasoning by structure-mapping -- aligning the relational structure of a known source with a target and carrying inferences across the alignment, deep relational structure driving the match, not surface features -- across the retrieval, mapping, inference, and schema subprocesses (Gentner; Gick & Holyoak)

card.wire: Attaches at Process. The root (process_analogy.md) declares analogy as reasoning by structure-mapping: a persona aligns the relational structure of a known source domain with a target and carries inferences across the alignment (Gentner). What makes the analogy sound is the systematicity of the match -- deep, interconnected relations, above all causal ones, rather than shared surface features; a good analogy transfers a system of relations, not a resemblance. Where the framing engine owns the rhetorical shaping of a claim, this engine owns the reasoning and transfer mechanism beneath a comparison. It routes into four subprocesses of the mapping.
card.issue: Four subprocesses of structure-mapping (Gentner; Gick & Holyoak). Retrieval: a source analog is called to mind from a target -- the access step, driven notoriously by surface similarity even where sound mapping needs relational similarity. Mapping: the structural alignment itself, one-to-one correspondences set between the elements of source and target under parallel connectivity and systematicity. Inference: the candidate inferences, the source's unmatched relations projected across the alignment onto the target as new predictions. Schema: the shared relational structure abstracted into a general schema that outlives the pair and eases the next transfer. The four run in sequence but each can be the one a scene turns on.
card.require: The law is declared once in the project's Instructions Knowledge chapter, linking the root. Each persona links, under Projection, the subprocess its analogical reasoning is in -- retrieval, mapping, inference, or schema.
card.enforce: Structure is checked; coherence is judged. The kit verifies the floor: the law is declared and each persona links a real analogy subprocess. Whether the reasoning is true to the persona -- a mapping of relational structure and not mere surface resemblance, sound in its correspondences and honest about what it transfers, and kept distinct from the rhetorical framing it may serve -- is semantic, taught and reviewed, never failed by the suite.
card.setup: Declare the law in the Instructions Knowledge chapter, linking the root. Give the persona its subprocess under Projection: retrieval when a source is being called to mind, mapping when the structures are being aligned, inference when a prediction is carried across, schema when the shared structure is being abstracted. Prize systematicity -- let the analogy turn on deep relational and causal structure, and let a surface-only match be the error the reasoning risks. Keep it the reasoning, not the rhetoric: the persuasive framing of a claim, including framing by metaphor, is the framing engine's; this engine owns the structure-mapping and transfer beneath it.
